speaker: The Rescuer
before: Finish it, Tess. I'll be here. I've had a lot of practice waiting in this forest.
after: Go and finish it, Tess. I'll be here when you come up, and I've had a great deal of practice at waiting in this forest.

speaker: The Rescuer
before: The Lab is quiet. For the first time in ten years I can hear the trees from down there.
after: The Lab is quiet now, and for the first time in ten years I can hear the trees from down there.

speaker: The Rescuer
before: Dad is in {town}, listening to Maren. She let him have one slice of pie. One. I've never seen him so frightened.
after: Dad is in {town}, listening to Maren. She let him have one slice of pie and no more, and I've never seen him so frightened of anything.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
before: Only the worthy reach the top, they say. The worthy also bring water, if they've any sense.
after: Only the worthy reach the top, they say, and I've been saying it longest. What they leave out is that the worthy also bring water, if they've any sense, which I never had at your age.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
before: There's a mountain behind the station... and a barbell on top older than the regime. Older than me, nearly. Bring me a protein shake from the stand and I'll show you the way. Can't climb on an empty cup.
after: There's a mountain behind the station, and a barbell on top that's older than the regime... older than me, nearly. Bring me a protein shake from the stand and I'll show you the way. I can't climb on an empty cup.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
before: Water, friend. A protein shake from the stand will do. Don't spill it. I spilled one, the Festival year... where was I.
after: Water, friend... well, a protein shake from the stand will do nicely. Carry it steady and don't spill it. I spilled one myself, the Festival year, right down the front of my... now, where was I?

speaker: Old Man Mountain
before: That's the best water I've ever seen. Thank you. Rule one: never lift alone. Rule two... rule two was water.
after: Now that's the best water I've ever seen, and I've seen a fair bit of water. Thank you, friend. Rule one is never lift alone, and rule two... rule two was water, I think, or it is today.

speaker: Old Man Mountain
before: Mount Swolympus is open at last. Take the trail behind the station, and mind the thin air up top... never gets enough credit, thin air.
after: Mount Swolympus is open at last, and about time. Take the trail behind the station, go easy, and mind the thin air up top... it never gets enough credit, thin air, for how little of it there is.

speaker: (narration)
before: It breaks easily. Too easily. The pieces cut, and a shard of it goes on ahead of you to warn the room.
after: It breaks easily, far too easily. The pieces cut you, and a shard of it goes on ahead of you to warn the room.

speaker: (narration)
before: It is the first thing here that tastes like anything. You feel steadier.
after: It is the first thing down here that tastes like anything at all, and you feel steadier for it.

speaker: (narration)
before: Keycards, a petty cash tin, and a half-written resignation letter.
after: You find keycards, a petty cash tin and a resignation letter that somebody got halfway through writing.

speaker: The Rescuer (Elowen)
before: Whatever he says in there, he'll say it kindly. That's the worst part. Don't listen to the voice, Tess. Watch the hands.
after: Whatever he says in there, he'll say it kindly, and he'll mean it kindly too. So don't listen to the voice, Tess. Watch the hands.

speaker: (narration)
before: Let him find it open. Let him wonder who read it.
after: You leave it open at the last entry, so that he will find it there and wonder who has read it.

speaker: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
before: Subject 1, and my daughter too! Both of you home at once. I shall have to rearrange the whole schedule.
after: Subject 1, and my daughter with you! Both of you home at once, and nobody thought to tell me. I shall have to rearrange the whole schedule, and I don't mind in the least.

speaker: The Rescuer (Elowen)
before: Tess. His Protocols run on switches, and I know where every one is. I'll take one down each turn. You do the rest.
after: Tess, listen. His Protocols run on switches, and I know where every one of them is. I'll take one down each turn, and you do the rest.

speaker: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
before: Subject 1, you came back to us! And you've grown. Remarkable, after so many cycles; I'll want measurements.
after: Subject 1, you came back to us! And you've grown, which is remarkable after so many cycles. I'll want measurements, of course, once you're settled.

speaker: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
before: Subject 1. Back where you belong. Do sit; the straps are new.
after: Subject 1, back where you belong at last. Do sit down; the straps are new, and I think you'll find them a good deal more comfortable.

speaker: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
before: This will only drain a little. You've grown, Subject 1. Remarkable.
after: This will only drain a little. You really have grown, Subject 1, and I find it quite remarkable.

speaker: Dr. Ambrose Siphon, Chief Path-ologist
before: Fascinating. My finest work, fighting back. I must write this down.
after: Fascinating! My finest work is fighting back, and with such spirit. Do carry on; I must write this down.

speaker: The Rescuer (Elowen)
before: No. It was yours too. Get up. You're going to {town}, and you're going to listen to every word Maren says.
after: No, Dad. It was yours too. Now get up, because you're going to {town}, and you're going to listen to every word Maren says.
